name: EmbeddedValue
summary: A value object mapped into the columns of the object that owns it, rather than into a table of its own.

roles.name: EmbeddedValue
roles.summary: A value whose fields become columns on the owner's row. It is what makes a rich value affordable — a money, a date range, an address stop being three loose columns without costing a join — and it is available exactly while nothing needs to query or share the value on its own.
